notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.36
Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.35
notes.content: [h2]Fixed Issues[/h2]  [list]    [*][b]Abyss Removal[/b]: Nanika falling into the abyss was still listed as active; now properly removed.[/*]    [*][b]Rebound Effect[/b]: Corrected the display logic so rebound visuals appear as intended.[/*]    [*][b]Illegal Session Matchmaking[/b]: Prevented matchmaking from failing when invalid sessions are present.[/*]    [*][b]Stat Recording[/b]: Buff gains, debuff applications, debuff received, and debuff removals are now logged accurately.[/*]  [/list]  [h2]New Features[/h2]  [list]    [*][b]Auto-Drop[/b]: While holding the drop key, Nanika will automatically drop.[/*]    [*][b]Damage Effect[/b]: Added visual damage effects for clearer combat feedback.[/*]    [*][b]Player Counts by Mode[/b]: Game mode dropdown now shows real-time player counts per game mode.[/*]  [/list]

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.34
notes.content: [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2] [list] [*]Fixed a bug where skills would not activate during combos.[/*] [/list]

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.33
notes.content: [h2]Added Features[/h2][list]  [*][b]Region Selection Feature[/b]: Players can now select their residential region when launching the game for the first time.[/*]  [*][b]Quick Matchmaking[/b]: Added a fast matching feature that allows players to immediately join any game mode.[/*][/list][h2]Improvements[/h2][list]  [*][b]Ranked Mode Matching Improvement[/b]: Reduced waiting time for matches in ranked mode by increasing the acceptable rating difference.[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]  [*][b]Fixed Class Skill Description Display Issue[/b]: Fixed an issue where class skill descriptions were not displaying correctly.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.32
notes.content: [h2]Game System Improvements[/h2]    [list]      [*][b]Deck Auto-Correction Feature[/b]: The system will now automatically correct decks containing illegal Nanika.[/*]      [*][b]Forced Nanika Drop Function[/b]: Added a feature that automatically forces Nanika to be dropped in specific situations.[/*]      [*][b]Round End Victory Logic[/b]: Fixed the logic that determines winners at the end of rounds.[/*]    [/list]    [h2]Interface and Display Improvements[/h2]    [list]      [*][b]Live Patch Visualization[/b]: Download progress for live patches can now be visually tracked.[/*]      [*][b]Live Patch Retry Function[/b]: Added a retry feature for users experiencing download issues.[/*]      [*][b]Level Up Display Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where the “LEVEL UP” text would remain on screen when a match starts during level up.[/*]      [*][b]Lobby UI Minor Fixes[/b]: Improved usability and visibility of the lobby interface.[/*]      [*][b]Class and Class Skill Selection Screen Improvements[/b]: Enhanced visibility for better user experience.[/*]    [/list]    [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]    [list]      [*][b]Party Information Sync[/b]: Fixed an issue where game mode and team size information wasn’t properly sent to the party when returning from a match.[/*]      [*][b]Spike × Makibishi Interaction[/b]: Fixed a problem where touching makibishi while having spikes would cause damage to opponents.[/*]      [*][b]Reflection Effect Malfunction[/b]: Fixed an issue where players would still take damage despite having the reflection effect active.[/*]      [*][b]Shield Recording Error[/b]: Fixed a problem where shield acquisition amounts weren’t being recorded correctly.[/*]      [*][b]Party Leader Selection[/b]: Fixed an issue where the party leader was determined by turn order when returning to the lobby.[/*]      [*][b]Nanika Size Adjustments[/b]: Optimized the size of Okra and Potato.[/*]    [/list]

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.31
notes.content: [h2]■ New Features[/h2][list]  [*][b]Automatic Live Patch Application[/b]: Latest patches will now be automatically applied without requiring client restart.[/*]  [*][b]Skill Activation Sounds Added[/b]: Sound effects will now play when skills are activated.[/*][/list][h2]■ Improvements[/h2][list]  [*][b]Nanika Activation Timing Adjustment[/b]: Previously, Nanika's ability would activate immediately after being summoned or dropped onto the field. Now, there will be a cooldown period before activation.[/*]  [*][b]Time-Out Victory Condition Change[/b]: When time runs out, if both teams have equal HP, the winner will now be determined based on score.[/*][/list][h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2][list]  [*][b]Fixed Issue with Stones Appearing on Field Edges[/b]: Fixed an issue where Nanika could be generated outside the playable area when using skills that summon Nanika to random locations on the opponent's field.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver.0.30
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented playlists from playing.

notes.title: Nanika Game Online Patch Notes Ver. 0.29
notes.content: [h2]■ UI Improvements[/h2][list]  [*]Display assigned key under each skill icon[/*]  [*]Show class and class‐skill descriptions in the lobby[/*]  [*]Refine rank change animations (enhanced shadows, smoother transitions)[/*]  [*]Fix match history display order (now newest first)[/*]  [*]Expand leaderboard column widths to prevent text clipping[/*]  [*]Show tooltips on class and class‐skill icons during gameplay[/*]  [*]Resolve issue where pre-match UI sometimes failed to appear[/*][/list][h2]■ Features & Adjustments[/h2][list]  [*]Revise rank rating gain/loss calculation logic for fairer matches[/*]  [*]Introduce disconnection penalty (RR deduction on mid-match leave)[/*]  [*]Improve unranked matchmaking by widening acceptable RR range[/*]  [*]Correct score offset issues on the post-match scoreboard[/*]  [*]Change default skill key bindings from Q/E/C to Q/W/E[/*][/list][h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2][list]  [*]Fix forced Discord authentication at each launch[/*]  [*]Fix issue where lobby cards remained visible after match start[/*]  [*]Fix pre-match freeze where players couldn’t move[/*][/list]

      [u]Reason:[/u] To streamline matchmaking and reduce wait times.[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]  [*][b]Leaderboard Display:[/b] Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not appear after returning to the game.[/*][/list]
